cs.t: I still primarily use an iPhone SE, but every couple of months I'll "disconnect" by using a dumbphone for a week or two at a time.  I use the Nokia 106:   https://www.nokia.com/phones/en_int/nokia-106/  I like it a lot.  It's cheap, simple, and has great battery life; I charge it perhaps once during the week or so I'm using it.  I paid £18 for mine unlocked. My favourite antifeature is that  it has no camera .  Most dumbphones have a camera in them that's so poor it's not worth having.  This one doesn't bother with one at all, which means there's no camera option cluttering up the menus.
